title: Casio Men Digital Watch AE-1500WHC-1AVDF
description:
A multifunctional digital watch with wide, easy-read display — perfect for the sports scene.

Water-resistant up to 100 meters, ten-year battery life, LED backlight, as well as handy features like stopwatch, alarm, and more.
